name: Let Us Brew an AI Model — release manifest
description: Canonical single release record: tag, tag-target commit, PDF build commit, PDF sha256, and the four corrected-run tokenizer file hashes. Asserted by scripts/verify_release.py (phase D) against git, the built PDF, and the files on disk. The tokenizer hashes are the SHA-256 of each tokenizer FILE ON DISK (the reproducible identifier the book cites); run manifests additionally record each tokenizer's in-memory vocabulary hash, which is a different quantity.
